purpose: Replace the visibly synthetic perfectly-planar diamond-lamina response in the generated fallback foliage with a shallow deterministic midrib fold and mild natural asymmetry while preserving the established branch/twig attachment, two-sided topology, morphology diversity, material optics and four-level LOD identity. Source checks award zero Visual Fidelity points; native 3840x2160 rendered evidence remains authoritative.

biologicalReasoning.assembly: woody twig -> leaf-cluster transform -> thin petiole-implied attachment -> lamina with tip-to-base midrib fold; this pass changes only lamina vertex positions inside existing generated spray meshes
biologicalReasoning.dimensionsThickness: Generated laminae remain thin two-sided surfaces rather than solid slabs. The fold depth is 8.5-15.5% of lamina half-width, producing a shallow V around the tip-to-base midrib. Right/left longitudinal asymmetry is limited to +/-3.5% of leaf length and tip/base lateral asymmetry to +/-1.8% of leaf width.
biologicalReasoning.materialFinish: No optical values are authored by this geometry pass. Living-leaf albedo, dielectric F0, roughness, normal map, transmission and exposure remain governed by the foliage optical/material contracts and NewTown/FoliageTransmission shader.
biologicalReasoning.mounting: LeafCluster transforms, tree placement, branch/twig construction and gameplay colliders are unchanged. Folded laminae stay inside the existing spray asset coordinate frame and therefore retain the same branch attachment hierarchy.
biologicalReasoning.interfacesGapsSeals: Vegetation has no manufactured seals. The relevant natural interface is petiole-implied lamina-to-cluster attachment; this pass may not introduce detached/floating leaf clusters or alter woody interfaces.
biologicalReasoning.orientationExposure: Fold sign and bounded asymmetry are deterministic per generated mesh/leaf so neighboring laminae do not share one perfectly planar highlight response. Lighting remains the coherent midsummer Japanese sun, sky fill, contact, occlusion and reflection environment.
biologicalReasoning.aging: No tears, scorch, storm damage, disease, disaster or reconstruction cue is generated. Ordinary midsummer leaf variation remains material/exposure-side and must be cause-based if expanded later.

geometry: existing leaf silhouette and morphology scale
geometryVsMaterialDetail.forbiddenShortcut: Do not paint a central highlight, edge darkening, fake fold shadow or silhouette breakup into albedo to imitate three-dimensional lamina curvature.

meshPolicy.reason: The upstream high-detail tree generator intentionally recreates base spray assets. A benchmark-scene save binding folds any regenerated planar sprays before downstream morphology/capture; derived variants then inherit the physical fold from the base sprays.

hardFailRules: a required base or derived generated leaf-spray mesh is missing at formal capture time
a generated spray no longer consists of contiguous eight-vertex two-sided lamina groups
triangle topology drifts from four triangles/twelve indices per lamina
front/back duplicate positions separate enough to create a fake thick slab or z-gap
any lamina remains effectively planar below the 3 degree source fold minimum
any lamina exceeds the 28 degree source fold maximum before rendered review
lamina UV0, normals or tangents are incomplete after folding
folding changes tree placement, branch/twig construction, LeafCluster transforms, colliders or foliage material values
painted/baked highlights or fold shadows are introduced into albedo
source fold checks are represented as rendered Visual Fidelity evidence

reviewFor: leaf highlights break naturally across the shallow midrib fold rather than reading as flat cards
no immediately obvious diamond-card silhouette at benchmark distance
no detached/floating leaf cluster introduced by curvature
no metallic/plastic flash from the changed geometric normals
no severe leaf-edge aliasing, normal shimmer or moire at grazing view
no lamina geometry snap through LOD cross-fades
dappled shadows remain plausible and do not become faceted starbursts
crown remains plausible as ordinary healthy midsummer vegetation

expectedVisualScoreImpact.vegetation_natural_complexity: direct positive candidate; removes the perfectly planar lamina BRDF/silhouette response but requires actual pixels before points
expectedVisualScoreImpact.lighting_shadows_reflections: secondary positive candidate through more physical leaf normal orientation and dapple response; render-unverified
expectedVisualScoreImpact.temporal_lod_aliasing: mixed-risk candidate: geometric normal diversity can reduce synchronous flashes but may increase shimmer, therefore native temporal evidence is mandatory

limitations: This is a generic healthy deciduous-lamina construction, not a claim of species-specific botanical reconstruction.
Eight vertices are retained for realtime cost and compatibility; the source fold is intentionally shallow and cannot reproduce fine edge serration or high-order leaf warping.
Static geometry checks cannot prove that the fold is visible at the benchmark camera distance or that it avoids temporal shimmer.
Authored replacement tree assets intentionally supersede the generated fallback and require their own render review if present.
